names.official: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

summary: Sri Lanka's ETA portal says a traveller planning a holiday visit, a short business trip or a transit needs to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) before arrival. Its fee table gives USD 50 for a tourist ETA (USD 20 for South Asian countries), or USD 60 (USD 25) on arrival, and says that from 25 May 2026 nationals of 40 listed countries, including India, China and Russia, can obtain the tourist ETA free of charge for 30 days.

visaTypes.name: Tourist Visa (ETA) with Double Entry for 30 days

fee.notes: The ETA portal lists USD 50 for countries outside South Asia and USD 20 for South Asian countries. It says the tourist ETA is free for 30 days for nationals of 40 listed countries from 25 May 2026, for Singapore and Seychelles (30 days) and the Maldives (90 days) under reciprocal and bilateral agreements, and for children of any nationality under 12 (up to 30 days).

faq.question: Do US citizens need a visa for Sri Lanka?
faq.answer: Yes — the ETA portal says travellers need to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) before arrival. Its fee table lists the United States of America among the 40 countries whose nationals, from 25 May 2026, can obtain the tourist ETA free of charge for 30 days; the tourist visa is listed with double entry for 30 days.

faq.question: Which nationalities get Sri Lanka's ETA free of charge?
faq.answer: The ETA portal says that from 25 May 2026 nationals of 40 listed countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, India, China, Russia and Japan, can obtain the tourist ETA free of charge for 30 days, and that under reciprocal and bilateral agreements Singapore and Seychelles (30 days) and the Maldives (90 days) can too. It says a traveller needs to apply and obtain an ETA before arrival.

faq.question: Can I extend my 30-day stay in Sri Lanka?
faq.answer: Yes. The Department of Immigration and Emigration's tourist visa extension fee chart runs in bands counted from arrival — days 31–90, 91–180 and 181–270. To reach day 90 it charges USD 60 for any country it does not name, and USD 100 for the United States and for the countries it names, including the UK, Canada and Australia. The ETA portal says short-term extensions beyond 30 days are applied for at eservices.immigration.gov.lk after you arrive.

faq.question: How long does the Sri Lanka ETA take?
faq.answer: No official source we could read states how long an online ETA application takes. The ETA portal says Sri Lanka's overseas missions issue an ETA or short-stay visa within 3 business days, and advises keeping a copy of the ETA approval to produce at the port of entry.

faq.question: What documents does Sri Lanka require on arrival?
faq.answer: The ETA portal says all ETA holders should have, at the port of entry, a passport valid for not less than 6 months from the date of arrival, a confirmed return ticket and sufficient funds to meet expenses during the stay, and advises keeping a copy of the ETA approval. Canada's travel advice says you will also need to fill out an online arrival card, which you can complete 3 days before arriving.
